items.title: Tom Porrello interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 6, 2023
items.q: I switched to a Bob Reeves mouthpiece. But he copied it except for the backbore, he copied if off of that mouthpiece. So the Bob Reeves, I still play that one.

ctx.x: Do you think you guys would talk shop like okay what mouthpiece are you playing now?

Oh that goes on all the time. My wife always breaks up if anybody comes over the house and says, “You guys can talk about trumpets and mouthpieces for like three days without stopping.” But I’ll tell you something funny about me. I’m not much of a changer like a lot of them are. Some guys have over 100 mouthpieces. I played a Bach 10-3/4 CW when I was a kid in high school and all that. And when I moved to LA I switched to a Bob Reeves mouthpiece. But he copied it except for the backbore, he copied if off of that…
